name: skills-hub
description: Personal curated skill hub: own skills plus vendored, reviewed upstream skills. Single marketplace consumed by all GeorgeBoxs project repos.

metadata.description: 102 skills in 10 domain plugins. Versions intentionally omitted so consumers auto-update by git SHA on every merged commit.

plugins.name: george-core
plugins.description: Own skills: ship-gate (pre-production audit), agent-harness (bounded agentic loops), handoff (session handoff docs), landing (self-contained HTML landing pages), market-research (TAM/SAM/SOM methodology), design-references (real design systems to ground UI work).

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Design and UX: epic-design (cinematic scroll/motion), brand-guidelines, ui-design-system, ux-researcher-designer, apple-hig-expert, a11y-audit (WCAG 2.2 AA), senior-frontend.

plugins.name: landing-cro
plugins.description: Landing pages and conversion: landing-page-generator (Next.js TSX), page-cro, signup-flow-cro, form-cro, onboarding-cro, copywriting, marketing-psychology.

plugins.name: product
plugins.description: Product management: product-strategist (OKRs), product-discovery, product-manager-toolkit (RICE, PRDs), product-analytics, experiment-designer (A/B), competitive-teardown, roadmap-communicator, saas-scaffolder, spec-to-repo.

plugins.name: growth
plugins.description: Growth and marketing: marketing-strategy-pmm, launch-strategy, pricing-strategy, seo-audit, programmatic-seo, schema-markup, aeo (AI answer engines), content-strategy, referral-program, analytics-tracking (GA4/GTM), email-sequence, churn-prevention, app-store-optimization.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Engineering: agent-workflow-designer, api-design-reviewer, api-test-suite-builder, ci-cd-pipeline-builder, database-designer, sql-database-assistant, migration-architect, monorepo-navigator, env-secrets-manager, git-worktree-manager, pr-review-expert, spec-driven-workflow, tech-debt-tracker.

plugins.name: business
plugins.description: Business operations: sales-engineer, revenue-operations, customer-success-manager, contract-and-proposal-writer.

plugins.name: c-level
plugins.description: Virtual C-suite (32 skills): 14 role advisors (CEO, CTO, CFO, CMO, COO, CPO, CRO, CHRO, CISO, CAIO, CDO, CCO, general counsel, VP Eng), founder-coach, chief-of-staff, board tooling (board-meeting, board-deck-builder), and strategy ops (scenario-war-room, ma-playbook, intl-expansion, competitive-intel, strategic-alignment, decision-logger, company-os, context-engine, org-health-diagnostic, culture-architect, change-management, internal-narrative, cs-onboard, agent-protocol).
